tools.what: Turns your rough notes and the call transcript into clean notes. No bot joins the call.

tools.name: Superhuman
tools.what: Splits your inbox so important mail comes first and drafts replies in your tone.

tools.what: Books focus time and habits on your calendar and moves them when meetings land.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.what: Describe a workflow in plain English and its AI builds and runs the automation.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: Gamma
tools.what: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a designed slide deck in about a minute.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.what: Records what Claude Code does, compresses it into short notes and loads them into your next session. Open source (Apache-2.0). Install: npx claude-mem install
tools.video: Claude Code forgets everything. This fixes that.

tools.name: Mika
tools.what: An AI agent for Android that works your apps and the web on a hidden screen while you keep using your phone. Free, Apache-2.0. Needs Android 11+ and your own AI model key.
tools.video: Your phone can now use its own apps

tools.name: Floorplan
tools.what: A Claude Code and Codex plugin that draws a plain-English map of your codebase and runs a health check (keys in code, open tables, risky endpoints). MIT.
tools.video: AI built your app. Now see how it works.

tools.name: Subvocal
tools.what: YC startup building glasses that turn silently mouthed words into text using radio waves and an AI model. Prototype; the team plans to ship in Q1 2027. Source: their Show HN post.
tools.video: These glasses let you type without a sound

tools.name: Kikumap
tools.what: A free, open-source Mac menu-bar app that shows which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting, and lays them out as a mind map. Unofficial; macOS 13+.
tools.video: Too many AI chats open? Map them.

tools.name: Claude vs ChatGPT (Nov 2026)
tools.what: Coding: Claude Code 62 vs Codex 55. Budget: GPT-6.1 Sol scores 55 at $1.27 per task vs Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and $10.04. Hard questions: 58 vs 57, a tie. Data from Artificial Analysis, Nov 3 2026.
